title: Give Claude access to your meetings in Simon Says
canSearch: search and read the meetings you can see in Simon Says
canTasks: see your tasks and tick them off, as when you tick them in the app
canAgenda: add points to the next agenda in a förening, and prepare it if needed
cannotTitle: Claude will not be able to
cannotEdit: change or delete notes and minutes
cannotMore: see more than you see in Simon Says
revokeHint: You can revoke access at any time under Account → Connected AI assistants.
notOpenText: The Claude connection is being tested and is not open for your account yet.
expiredText: Start the connection again from Claude.
errorTitle: The connection could not be started
errorClient: Simon Says does not recognise the app that tried to connect. Remove the connection in Claude and add it again.
errorRedirect: The app tried to send you to an address it has not registered. It was stopped for your safety.
panelIntro: AI assistants you have given access to your meetings, such as Claude. They only see what you see.
panelHowTo: Add to Claude: Settings → Connectors → Add custom connector with the address {url}. In Claude Code: claude mcp add --transport http simon-says {url}
revokeConfirm: Revoke access for {client}? The assistant will no longer reach your meetings.
revokeFailed: Access could not be revoked. Try again.
auditIntro: What the assistants did: tool and time, never content.
